tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badzra bi dā ra nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la rab tu bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// de nas lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje khro bo las byung ba rdo rje'i dam tshig smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las rnam par thar bar byed pa// 'byung po thams cad 'gug par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad rmugs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad rmongs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma shtsanḍa badzra yā ṇa ye/ ma hā yakṣa se ṇā pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ sphu ṭa sphu ṭa/ spho ṭā ya spho ṭa ya/ ghurna ghurna/ ghurna pa ya ghurna pa ya/ sarba sa twa naṃ/ bo dha bo dha/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ po dha ya/

tra sa tra sa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bha ma bha ma/ saṃ bha ma ya saṃ bha mā ya/ sarba bhu tā ni/ ku ṭa ku ṭa/ saṃ ku ṭa ya saṃ ku ṭa ya/ sarba sha trunnāṃ/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭā ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bidyaṃ badzra badzra/ spho ṭā ya badzra badzra/ ka ṭa ya badzra badzra/ ma ṭa badzra badzra/ ma tha badzra badzra/ badzra aṭṭa sa ha nī la badzra/ su badzra ya swā hā/ he phu lu ni ru phu lu ni gri hna ku lu/ mi li/ tsu lu/ ghu nu/ phul lu/ ku ru ku lu/ badzra bi dzā ya swā hā/ ki li kī lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo tra na pra mo ṭa na ya swā hā/ tsa ra ṇi shtsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badzra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ tshindha tshindha/ bhindha bhindha/ ma hā badzra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ bandha bandha/ kro dha kro dha/ ma hā badzra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsanḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ma hā badzra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badzra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badzra pra bhañtsa nā ya swā hā/ ma ti sthi ra badzra/ shru ti sthi ra badzra/ pra ti sthi ra badzra/ ma hā badzra/ a pra ti ha ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ e hye hi/ shī ghraṃ badzra dhā ra ye swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badzra ku laṃ ā warta ya swā hā/ sarba bighnan shra tūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs manta badzra ṇaṃ/ sarba ba laṃ ā warta ya/ ma hā ba le ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ manḍa le ma ye/ a ti badzra/ ma hā ba la be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dzwa la dzwa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ biṅga la/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ bandha bandha/ ma hā ba le/ sarba badzra aṃ ku shwa dzwa lā ya swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mashtsanḍa badzra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yakṣa se na pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badzra/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dhu na dha na badzra/ ha na ha na badzra/ da ha da ha badzra/ pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ dha ra dha ra badzra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badzra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badzra/

tshindha tshindha badzra/ bhindha bhindha badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ na ma shtsanḍa badzra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭhātiṣṭha/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ a mri te hūṃ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*// phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*// lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*// mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*// bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*// phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*/ nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*// 'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byed stems dang*// mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*// mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi// rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*// de ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis/ mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya// gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi// mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*// de dag thams cad zhi bar blta// tshe dang bsod nams rnam par 'phel/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ nor bu yungs kar durba dang*// rin chen rma med tsan dan bcas// shel dang rdo rje mu tig dang*// chu yis gser ram yang na ni// dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkris shing dag /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad// rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni// rgyal po ltar du khrus gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ phyag na rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// gzungs mdo 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun tā ra nā thas zhus dag gnang ba'i dpe las bris pa'o/// /bkra shis// shu bhaṃ/// /
